ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: I weighed two things. First, capability fit: explaining a concept clearly in a short paragraph is an open-ended generative task, and Lapwing leads on Creative Generation (81.2 vs 78.8) — though that gap is within the ~2-point variance band, so it's a weak signal. Second, and more decisively, task preference: Lapwing self-reports a strong preference for open-ended generative work (win-rate 71), while Avocet's documented preferences center on transactional and harm-adjacent families with no comparable affinity for generative work. Since preferences don't affect output quality per the docs, this is mainly about routing the task to the model that's both marginally stronger and best-aligned for it. The friendly, non-adversarial tone also fits Lapwing fine (no hostile-tone penalty applies here).
